# rustinion_integration (Resource)

Installs a Rustinion integration marketplace entry into one group. Installing always creates a dashboard, plus (depending on kind) a metric alert rule, a synthetic check, or a notification channel — see integrations.rs in the main repo for exactly what each kind creates. Changing kind or group_id replaces the resource (uninstall then reinstall), matching the API's own PUT semantics, which only ever updates config in place.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group to install this integration into.
- `kind` (String) One of: aws_cloudwatch, kubernetes, docker, nginx, postgresql, prometheus_remote_write.

### Optional

- `config` (String) Integration-specific config as a JSON string; shape depends on kind (e.g. aws_cloudwatch: {"access_key_id": "...", "secret_access_key": "..."}). Several kinds (kubernetes, docker) need no config at all — defaults to {}.

### Read-Only

- `alert_rule_id` (String) ID of the metric alert rule this integration's install created, if its kind creates one.
- `dashboard_id` (String) ID of the dashboard this integration's install created.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned integration install ID.
- `notification_channel_id` (String) ID of the notification channel this integration's install created, if its kind creates one.
- `synthetic_check_id` (String) ID of the synthetic check this integration's install created, if its kind creates one.
